comments.body:
## Review and fixes for rm-09486

Reviewed problem.tex, solution.tex, issue.json. The two self-contained parts are correct: (i) arbitrary complexity via Z^{n+1} with the trivial family (gd=cd=n+1>n, Poincare duality on T^m gives the lower bound, finite K(Z^m,1) the upper bound); (ii) the FIN side (torsion-free => FIN=TR, finite-dim K(Γ,1) => finite-dim E_FIN).

GAP FIXED: The original Thm thm:LW (Lück–Weiermann) presented the inequality gd_VC Γ ≥ sup_[C] cd(W_C) as a cited theorem with a hand-wavy embedded "proof" (mapping cylinder), and thm:LP secretly derived gd_VC=∞ through that unproven inequality. I (1) restated thm:LW as only the genuine, quotable push-out; (2) moved the unproven inequality into a clearly-labeled motivational Remark not used in the logical chain; (3) recast thm:LP to cite the *published conclusion* gd_VC Γ = cd_VC Γ = ∞ (Leary–Petrosyan Thm B) as a black box; (4) rewrote thm:main to depend only on (torsion-free + cocompact finite-dim K(Γ,1) + gd_VC=∞); (5) removed over-specific "cd=3 / 3-dimensional" claims in statement, abstract, conclusion. Environments balanced, all refs/cites resolve; no toolchain so compile skipped.

Status: gap resolved; proof rigorous with a single isolated black-box citation.

comments.body:
## Additional verification + explicit-example fix

Building on the prior black-box restructuring (already in solution.tex), I independently re-verified the mathematics and added one improvement.

**Verified (symbolic/numeric):**
- Thm thm:arb: H^*(Z^m;Z) = exterior algebra on m degree-1 generators, top class in degree m of rank 1, so cd(Z^m)=gd(Z^m)=m and gd_TR(Z^{n+1})=n+1>n. Self-contained, correct.
- lem:restrict: numerically checked the double-coset decomposition Gamma/L = ⊔_{HgL} H/(H∩gLg^{-1}) (Gamma=S3, H=<(12)>, L=<(123)>); every H-orbit stabilizer is a subgroup of H, confirming dim_H X = dim_Gamma X and the fixed-point identity. Correct.
- Confirmed Z^n does NOT separate FIN/VC (Weyl groups of its infinite cyclic subgroups are ~Z^{n-1}, finite cd), so the deep Leary–Petrosyan input is genuinely necessary.

**Improvement applied:** The problem asks to *exhibit explicit examples*. I added Remark rem:explicit naming a concrete finitely presented torsion-free Leary–Petrosyan group: it acts freely cocompactly on a CAT(0) cube complex (hence finite K(Γ,1) and cocompact E_FIN Γ = E Γ), contains a nested family of infinite cyclic subgroups whose commensurator Weyl groups have cd → ∞, and has cd_VC = ∞ by their Theorem B. This turns the separation from an existence statement into an exhibited named example.

**Structure:** all environments balance; latex toolchain unavailable so compilation skipped.

Both deliverables are established rigorously, modulo the one properly-isolated deep theorem that the problem's nature requires. Keeping status resolved.
